containers.name: collector
command:
"""Run inside the isolated Analytics collection Job; only GETs reach openHAB."""
from copy import deepcopy
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import threading
import time
from backup_store import record_publications
from openhab_analytics.daily import DailyCatalog,run


def main():
    os.umask(0o077)
    root=Path('/store/daily');config=Path('/config/sources.json')
    before=DailyCatalog(root).request_view();original=(root/'active.json').read_bytes()
    old_answers={d:{'energy':{s:before.energy(s,d) for s in ('huddinge','landet')},'ev':before.ev('huddinge',d)} for d in before.index['days']}
    bad=json.loads(config.read_text());bad['sites']['huddinge']['base_url']='http://127.0.0.1:9'
    bad_path=Path('/tmp/unavailable-origin.json');bad_path.write_text(json.dumps(bad));bad_path.chmod(0o600)
    failure=run(root,bad_path,refresh_date='2026-10-20')
    assert failure['status']=='failed'
    assert (root/'active.json').read_bytes()==original
    assert DailyCatalog(root).request_view().energy('huddinge','2026-10-20')==old_answers['2026-10-20']['energy']['huddinge']
    print(json.dumps({'failure_probe':'passed','prior_generation_preserved':True,'error':failure['error']}),flush=True)
    record_publications(root)
    stopped=threading.Event();reads=[];reader_errors=[]
    def reader():
        while not stopped.is_set():
            try:
                view=DailyCatalog(root).request_view()
                energy=view.energy('huddinge','2026-10-20')
                assert energy['primary_item']=='Currently_One_Currently_Used' and energy['reported_load_energy_kwh'] is not None
                assert not view.ev('huddinge','2026-10-20')['automatic_house_deduction']
                reads.append(view.index['generation'])
            except Exception:reader_errors.append(True)
            stopped.wait(0.5)
    thread=threading.Thread(target=reader);thread.start()
    try: result=run(root,config,refresh_date='2026-10-20')
    finally:
        stopped.set();thread.join();record_publications(root)
    print(json.dumps({'live_collection':result}),flush=True)
    assert result['status']=='success'
    assert reads and not reader_errors
    after=DailyCatalog(root).request_view()
    assert after.index['generation']!=before.index['generation']
    assert before.energy('huddinge','2026-10-20')==old_answers['2026-10-20']['energy']['huddinge']
    for day in before.index['days']:
        if day=='2026-10-20':continue
        for site in ('huddinge','landet'):assert after.energy(site,day)==old_answers[day]['energy'][site]
        assert after.ev('huddinge',day)==old_answers[day]['ev']
    summaries=[]
    for site,item in [('huddinge','Currently_One_Currently_Used'),('landet','SigenStor_Total_Load')]:
        energy=after.energy(site,'2026-10-20');assert energy['primary_item']==item and not energy['automatic_fallback']
        summaries.append({'site':site,'primary_item':item,'reported_load_energy_kwh':energy['reported_load_energy_kwh'],
            'prior_kwh':old_answers['2026-10-20']['energy'][site]['reported_load_energy_kwh']})
    ev=after.ev('huddinge','2026-10-20');assert not ev['automatic_house_deduction']
    status=json.loads((root/'status.json').read_text());assert status['requests']>0
    proof={'status':'verified','generation':after.index['generation'],'previous_generation':before.index['generation'],
        'failure_preserves_catalog':True,'concurrent_reader_checks':len(reads),'unchanged_previous_days':True,
        'frozen_reader_preserved':True,'requests':status['requests'],'summaries':summaries,
        'ev_included':True,'automatic_house_deduction':False}
    print(json.dumps(proof),flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':
    try:main()
    except Exception:
        print('{"status":"failed","error":"collection_probe_failed"}',flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(2)
